title: Availability of Cat-breeding Locations for Rent
what_it_is: Availability of Cat-breeding Locations for Rent

sections.label: Cat breeding licensing and enforcement
sections.summary: NParks monitors demand for commercial cat breeding, prioritises units, requires licences, investigates illegal breeding, and cares for seized cats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to monitor the demand for commercial cat breeding and prioritise newly available units for cat breeding, where appropriate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under the Animals and Birds (Licensing of Farms) Rules, a valid licence is required to breed animals for commercial purposes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks investigates reports of the illegal commercial breeding of animals, including cats, and takes enforcement action against offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Cats seized during such investigations will be under the care of NParks and its veterinarians.

sections.label: Seized cats during investigations
sections.summary: Owners cannot visit seized cats during investigations, but cats remain under NParks care and are regularly assessed until investigations conclude.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As the animals are seized as part of investigations, owners will not be able to visit them while investigations are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: However, the cats will remain under the care of NParks and are regularly assessed by NParks, until investigations are concluded.

sections.label: The Animal Lodge availability
sections.summary: The Animal Lodge is currently the only one available, and NParks will track and work with industry to expand if demand is high.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Currently, The Animal Lodge is the only one available.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will keep track and work with the industry to see how we can expand it if there is high demand.
